lines.t: Thus says The Lord of Heaven and Earth:
and no more shall I allow all this iniquity to thrive before My face! No more shall I allow all these abominations to proliferate throughout the earth!
Thus says The Lord your Redeemer,
behold, with many tears I speak to you:
you have wandered far from Me,
You were to be My treasure!
Oh how I weep for you;
Turn aside and return to Me, for I call to you still!
in a world which seeks only to consume you!
There is no more time to tarry!
for The Father’s indignation to be poured out,
and all the children of disobedience shall come to know it!
Yes, all these insolent and rebellious peoples shall surely drink of it!
For there is but One Salvation,
only one name under Heaven by which you must be saved,
only One who can fulfill your heart’s innermost desire...
Beloved, come out from among them and be joined unto ME!...
Be sheltered from all these troubles which are coming
be spared from all these things
Which I am about to pour out upon this generation!...
Today is the day of salvation!
Thus have I spoken it and so shall it be,
For I swear by Myself, says The Lord,
